debtor.audience: a restrained pewter-and-charcoal counting room, a plain ivory commission and a single brass lamp

clerk.audience: a modest harbour-office audience, pewter-grey silk with simple trim, signing a first commission beside a single brass lamp

trader.audience: a welcoming harbour-office commission, verdigris silk and antique brass trim, a teak desk with a sealed commission and trading junks beyond the window

merchant.audience: a formal merchant reception, rich indigo silk with silver and antique brass details, carved screens and an ivory commission presented on a teak desk

senior_merchant.audience: a distinguished senior merchant audience, plum silk and black velvet with fine antique gold embroidery, warm lanterns and richly carved dark wood

merchant_prince.audience: a grand merchant-prince reception, copper-coloured silk with ornate antique gold embroidery, a ceremonial ivory commission, elaborate carved screens and harbour dusk

taipan.audience: the highest Taipan commission in an elegant treaty-port reception room, formal imperial-jade silk and black velvet with rich antique gold embroidery, a civic gold chain, an ivory commission on a teak table, carved screens and harbour dusk

tai_pan_china_seas.audience: a crimson-and-gold audience hall in a great treaty-port hong, lacquered crimson silk with heavy antique gold embroidery, a jade seal on a carved teak table and a harbour crowded with the house's own ships at dusk

merchant_lord.audience: a grand lantern-lit hall of a merchant lord, midnight-blue silk with lavish gold brocade, a ceremonial gold chain, an ivory commission and a fleet riding at anchor beyond tall carved windows

hong_master.audience: the highest audience in the China Seas, black velvet and cloth-of-gold, a jewelled civic chain, a gilded commission on a lacquer table, red lanterns and the whole harbour lit for the night
